visible.description: true shows the gifts on the shop, false hides them.

faulty.description: Goods turned out to be faulty: the delivery fee is refunded too.

resolution.description: Damaged goods only: send a replacement or refund in full.

password.description: Required for accounts that sign in with a password.

sendAt.description: When to deliver. Leave out to send as soon as the order is paid.

dryRun.description: Check the files and report, without saving anything.

email.description: Lets a guest use a first-gift code: we check whether this email has ordered before.

kind.description: "return": changed my mind (7 days). "damaged": arrived damaged (48 hours, photo needed).

lines.description: Positions (0, 1, ...) of the order lines to send back. Leave out for every returnable line.

photoUrls.description: Links to photos. Uploading files needs an object store, which is not set up yet.

sameDayCapacity.description: { "Karachi": 40 }: same-day orders a city can take in a day. A city left out has no limit.

info.description:
REST API for the Sentimently gift store. Money is in whole rupees (PKR). Times are ISO 8601 in UTC; delivery dates are plain dates in Pakistan time.

Sign in with POST /auth/login and send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Routes marked with no security need no token.

Every error has the shape { "error": { "code", "message", "details"?, "requestId" } }. Too many requests give 429 with a Retry-After header.

This is version 1 and is frozen: changes after the Backend Gate are additive, or a new /api/v2.
info.title: Sentimently API

parameters.description: One status or a comma-separated list, e.g. preparing,in_production
parameters.name: status
